name: Subtitle Detective
description: Detect subtitle languages, correct mislabeled embedded subtitle tracks, and standardize their display names without modifying original media files. This build is for Jellyfin 12.0 on Linux x64.
overview: Automatic subtitle language detection and metadata cleanup. Linux x64 build.

versions.changelog: REVIEW BUILD — hold public distribution pending Lingua model and extended OCR glyph redistribution clearance. Restricts library selection and operations to Movies and TV Shows.
Initial catalog package for testing. Linux x64 only.
